glosses: gorilla (largest of the apes, belonging to the genus Gorilla, native to the forests of central Africa and known for their trait of knuckle-walking)
goon, thug (muscular henchman with little intelligence)

examples.text: En réalité, le gorille a beaucoup de sentiments en commun avec les êtres humains.
examples.en: In fact, gorillas have many of the same feelings that people have.

examples.text: Elle le tint de la manière dont les mères-gorilles tiennent leurs bébés.
examples.en: She held him like mother gorillas hold their babies.
